name: restaurant-location-production-readiness
title: Harden restaurant current-location capture for production
description: Use the same browser-side reverse-geocoding path as Home across restaurant setup and customer addresses, with a backend fallback, then persist the resolved address and coordinates.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Manual Network inspection showed browser GPS succeeds but the backend reverse-geocode proxy cannot reach Nominatim. Home already succeeds with browser-side Nominatim. The shared helper now uses browser-side lookup first and the backend endpoint only as fallback. GitHub Actions run 28821226554 passed frontend and backend lint/tests/build plus Playwright smoke tests. Real address accuracy still depends on OpenStreetMap coverage and remains a manual review step.
